verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe snapshotting a running sandbox to resume later (docs-12), auto-snapshotting the filesystem and configuration on stop and restoring them on resume (docs-40, docs-11). They also say that creating from a snapshot is faster than starting from scratch (docs-31), which implies new sandboxes can be created from a snapshot. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of forking multiple new sandboxes from one snapshot, snapshot API/CLI details (create, list, delete, retention), independent or hands-on corroboration.
